A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DecoupleSearch work. All 14 pages in each version, including equations, five figures, six tables, and Appendices A–D, support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original five-dataset QA experiments, component ablations, expansion-size experiments, value-model analyses, and additional baseline comparisons in Appendix C.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and their results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: MCTS annotation, the shared policy model with two value heads, the joint training loss, and hierarchical beam search remain unchanged. Removing a duplicated word from the appendix evaluation prompt does not change the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, MuSiQue, Bamboogle, and TriviaQA, and describe the same training-query sources, including NQ. Dataset spelling corrections introduce no new coverage.

E2.justification: The comparator sets in Tables 1 and 6 are unchanged. Section 4.2 replaces 'AgenticRAG' with 'GreedyAgent', which was already evaluated in v1's Table 1 and defined immediately afterward. Self-RAG and Adaptive-RAG remain in Appendix C.

E3.justification: Section 4.4 changes the reported backbone from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M to Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, aligning it with Section 4.3 and Table 1. This is a limited correction to the stated model setting; the PDFs do not establish reruns. Sample counts, metrics, retrieval settings, and training budgets remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The component ablations in Table 2, expansion-size analysis in Table 3, value-ranking versus random-selection analysis in Figure 4, and case study in Figure 5 retain the same questions, evidence, and findings.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate and win/loss reporting. Neither adds repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results in Tables 1–3 and 5–6 and the findings displayed in Figures 4–5 are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains average EM/F1 of 39.93/38.79 for the 7B model and 44.63/42.50 for the 14B model.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, UCT criterion, reward updates, and training objective in Sections 2–3 and Equations 1–8 are unchanged. No assumptions, proofs, or derivations are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: decoupling planning and search with dual value models, MCTS-based supervision, hierarchical beam search, and effectiveness across five datasets and two model sizes.

C2.justification: The explanations of planning and search expansion, value-model ranking, and smaller-model competitiveness remain unchanged. Both versions retain the limitations concerning MCTS annotation costs and keeping only one promising plan and search result per step.

D1.justification: Appendix B's Training Cost paragraph changes '8 A800 GPUs' to '8 NVIDIA A100 80GB GPUs', resolving its inconsistency with the existing Training Process paragraph and Section 4.3. This corrects hardware documentation without establishing an actual hardware switch. Training times and resource links remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and bibliography are unchanged. Removing the Li et al. (2025) citation immediately after RAgent leaves that work cited for Search-o1 and does not change the cited-work set or substantive research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized corrections to grammar, punctuation, dataset capitalization, and baseline naming. It removes redundant contribution wording and the duplicated 'step' in Appendix D, and corrects Section 4.4's reference from Table 6 to Table 1. The section structure is retained.

P2.justification: Table headers correct 'MusiQue' to 'MuSiQue' and 'TrivaQA' to 'TriviaQA', with small text reflow elsewhere. All five figures are visually unchanged, and all six tables retain their structure and placement.

improvement.justification: v2 improves internal consistency by aligning the hardware description, backbone name, baseline name, and main-results table reference with information already present elsewhere in v1. These corrections make the paper easier to interpret and reproduce. The gain is limited because the method, empirical evidence, and substantive limitations remain unchanged.
